
```{r}
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(data.table)
insins <- read.xlsx("data\\fasting_insulin.xlsx")
refbio <- fread("data\\mse.txt.gz")
library(tidyverse)

```


```{r}

ins_clumped <- format_data(insins,
                          type = "exposure",
                          effect_allele_col = "A1",
                          beta_col = "BETA",
                          se_col = "SE",
                          other_allele_col = "A2",
                          pval_col = "P",
                          eaf_col = "EAF")

ins_data <- clump_data(ins_clumped, clump_r2 = 0.001)
```


```{r}
refractive_data <- merge(refbio,
                         ins_data,
                         by="SNP")

refractive_data <- unique(refractive_data)
```


```{r}
refractive_data <- data.frame(refractive_data)
ref_clumped <- format_data(refractive_data,
                           type = "outcome",
                           effect_allele_col = "EA",
                           beta_col = "BETA",
                           se_col = "SE",
                           other_allele_col = "NEA",
                           pval_col = "P",
                           eaf_col = "EAF")
```


```{r}
harmonised_ins_ref <- harmonise_data(exposure_dat = ins_data,
                                    outcome_dat = ref_clumped)
```



```{r}
F <- 
  harmonised_ins_ref$beta.exposure^2/harmonised_ins_ref$se.exposure^2
mF <- mean(F)
mF
```


```{r}
mr_ins_ref <- mr(harmonised_ins_ref, 
                method_list = "mr_ivw")
mr_ins_ref
```
```{r}
mr_scatter_plot(mr_ins_ref, harmonised_ins_ref)
```




```{r}
mr_heterogeneity(harmonised_ins_ref)
```


```{r}
mr_ins_ref_egg <-  mr(harmonised_ins_ref, 
                     method_list = "mr_egger_regression")
mr_ins_ref_egg

mr_ins_egg_int <- mr_pleiotropy_test(harmonised_ins_ref)

mr_ins_egg_int
```
```{r}
mr_scatter_plot(mr_ins_ref_egg, harmonised_ins_ref)
```


```{r}
mr_ins_ref_wm <-  mr(harmonised_ins_ref, 
                    method_list = "mr_weighted_median")
mr_ins_ref_wm
```


```{r}
mr_scatter_plot(mr_ins_ref_wm, harmonised_ins_ref)
```


# MR forest plot #

```{r}
mr_forest_plot(mr_singlesnp(harmonised_ins_ref))
```

This shows us that most of our SNPs cluster between -2 and 0D

```{r}
mrinsref <- mr(harmonised_ins_ref)
mrinsref
plotinsref <- mr_scatter_plot(mrinsref, harmonised_ins_ref)
plotinsref
```

```{r}
looivw <- mr_leaveoneout(harmonised_ins_ref)
looivw
plooivw <- mr_leaveoneout_plot(looivw)
plooivw
```
